findings.fix: Move `IsSignedTransverseZero` and `.congr` to TransverseZero.lean (or earlier). Restate `exists_contMDiffSection_complexEulerClass_eq_sum_sign` as `∀ z, σ z = 0 → IsSignedTransverseZero σ z (ε z)`.
findings.issue: `IsSignedTransverseZero` is introduced here, but its producer `exists_contMDiffSection_complexEulerClass_eq_sum_sign` (TransverseZero.lean:171-174) still states the identical `∃ D c, HasFDerivAt … ∧ ‖D - …‖ < ‖c‖` inline. That leaves two public forms of one condition, and `exists_contMDiff_divisorCore_equiv` has to convert between them.

findings.evidence: Line 211: `theorem fibreEquivOfNeZero_symm_apply … : (fibreEquivOfNeZero σ hσ z).symm w = w • σ z` has no attribute.
findings.issue: `fibreEquivOfNeZero_symm_apply` is the normal-form characterization of the inverse (`w ↦ w • σ z`), but it is not `@[simp]`. Because the definition's body is unexposed, no other simp lemma can reduce `(fibreEquivOfNeZero σ hσ z).symm w`.

findings.evidence: The only lemma about the def is `fibreEquivOfNeZero_symm_apply` (line 211); grep shows no other `fibreEquivOfNeZero_*` declaration in the diff.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem fibreEquivOfNeZero_apply_self : fibreEquivOfNeZero σ hσ z (σ z) = 1`. Also add `fibreEquivOfNeZero_apply_smul_self : fibreEquivOfNeZero σ hσ z (w • σ z) = w`, or state it via the symm lemma.
findings.issue: `fibreEquivOfNeZero` has no forward characteristic lemma, i.e. nothing saying it sends `σ z` to `1` or `v` to its coordinate. The docstring describes the map as the coordinate in the basis `σ z`, but users must unfold the body, which is built from `trivializationAt`, to prove this.

summary: `IsSignedTransverseZero` is added in Divisor.lean but the theorem that produces such zeros still states the condition inline, so two forms of the same condition coexist. `fibreEquivOfNeZero` lacks its forward characteristic lemma, and its symm lemma is not marked `@[simp]`.
